# ZarSignal — زرسیگنال

ZarSignal is a Persian decision-support product for gold, silver and currency markets.
It separates observed market facts, user inputs, calculations and model inferences.

## Current public capabilities

- `/`: market feed status, bubble placeholders, market table and basic calculator.
- `/risk-management`: educational risk amount, generic position size and risk/reward tools.
- `/methodology`: units, freshness policy, source disclosure and calculation limits.
- `/developers`: versioned API contract and authentication requirements.
- `/pricing`: plans published by an administrator; no invented prices.

## Data policy

When no verified live feed is connected, ZarSignal displays no market price.
Every future market value must include its unit, currency, source and observation time.
Unconfigured bubble, theoretical-value and trading formulas remain unavailable.

ZarSignal does not guarantee profit and does not provide undocumented buy/sell instructions.
